biography:
Research Note to add:
* '''Probable Civil War service.''' A William Avery, 19, born about 1842, enlisted at Yonkers in 1861 in the 17th New York Infantry and was mustered out on 2 June 1863.<ref name="averymr">"New York, U.S., Civil War Muster Roll Abstracts, 1861-1900", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/1965/records/363927 : accessed 18 November 2026), William Avery, age 19, born about 1842; enlisted 1861 at Yonkers, 17th Infantry; mustered out 2 Jun 1863.</ref> A William E. Avery served as a private in Company G of the 6th New York Heavy Artillery.<ref name="averynps">"U.S., Civil War Soldiers, 1861-1865", database, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/1138/records/2783019 : accessed 18 November 2026), William E. Avery, private, Co. G, 6th Regiment, New York Heavy Artillery; citing NARA microfilm M551, roll 4.</ref> In June 1890 William E. Avery of New York City reported service in Company A, 17th New York Infantry, from 19 April 1861 to 26 July 1865.<ref name="avery1890">"1890 Veterans Schedules of the U.S. Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/8667/records/938681 : accessed 18 November 2026), William E. Avery, New York, New York, enumeration district 417; private, Co. A, 17th N.Y. Inf., enlisted 19 Apr 1861, discharged 26 Jul 1865; citing NARA microfilm M123.</ref> He applied for an invalid pension on 21 May 1879. His widow Lizzie applied on 25 September 1891.<ref name="averypen">"U.S., Civil War Pension Index: General Index to Pension Files, 1861-1934", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/4654/records/1905360 : accessed 18 November 2026), William E. Avery, A 17 N.Y. Inf. and G 6 N.Y. H.A.; invalid application 287,279 filed 21 May 1879; widow Lizzie Avery, application 527,367 filed 25 Sep 1891, New York; citing NARA microfilm T288.</ref> This is probably Hattie's father. He was William (perhaps William Edward) Avery of New York City, who may have died in Manhattan on 26 August 1891 and may have remarried about 1881. The pension file should settle it.
